ShadDialog.name: ShadDialog
ShadDialog.description: Dialog or side sheet (ToolJet Modal in the pack look): header, body and footer canvases (put a ShadHeading and a muted ShadText in the header, the form in the body, ShadButtons in the footer); open and close it with the show-modal / close-modal event actions or its open and close actions; exposed show. defaultValue.text: Describe what this dialog is for.

nativeSlots.rule: Put the modal title Text in header, fields/content in body, and native action buttons in footer. Do not leave showHeader enabled with an empty header and add a duplicate title row to the body.
nativeSlots.parentRule: Set parent_ref for a same-batch modal or parent for an existing modal; coordinates are relative to the selected slot canvas.

closeLifecycle.rule: Put transient selected-record/form cleanup on ModalV2 onClose, not only on a Cancel button: native X and enabled Escape/outside-dismiss paths must not leave stale selection. If a Table opens the detail modal, deselect its row on close when needed so clicking that same row again can reopen its details. Keep cleanup idempotent and never write or delete database records as cleanup.
closeLifecycle.verification: Test Cancel, native X, each enabled dismissal path and successful-save close, then reopen the same record and a different record. Do not assume a working Cancel proves every close path.

authoringHints.composition: Header: a ShadHeading (level "h4") with a muted ShadText description under it; body: the content or form; footer: ShadButtons, an outline Cancel then the primary action, right-aligned. Set useDefaultButton false and open it with show-modal from a ShadButton or a table row event. variant "sheet" (side "right") is a full-height side panel for record details and edit forms; "dialog" is centred for confirmations and short forms. Body of a record-details sheet: one FlexContainer column holding, top to bottom, the headline figure or status (a ShadStat or a ShadBadge), one ShadKeyValue for the fields (data an array of { label, value, type } from the selected record, columns 2, layout "stacked"), then longer notes in a ShadText; never label and value ShadTexts placed by hand on a grid. Footer: every button inside one FlexContainer row (justifyContent "flex-end", gap 8), the outline or ghost action first, the primary last. Read the record as components.<table>?.selectedRow?.<field> ?? '-', or guard on components.<table>?.selectedRow?.id: a selection is {} when nothing is selected, which is truthy.

ShadHero.name: ShadHero
ShadHero.description: Page hero at the top of a page: eyebrow (small caps line above), title, subtitle, meta facts (['Sun, 11 Oct', '14 bookings'] or [{ label, value }]), an aside on the right and up to two actions (actionLabel, secondaryActionLabel; onActionClicked, onSecondaryActionClicked). The aside is one headline figure (asideValue 12480 or '$12,480', asideLabel 'Revenue today' above it) or a short list of facts (asideValue [{ label: 'Open', value: 14 }, { label: 'Due today', value: 3 }], up to 4, asideLabel as their heading). Greetings and header facts belong in the hero itself: 'Good morning, Ada' as the title, one line of what needs attention as the subtitle, today's date and counts as meta chips, the one number that matters in the aside; never a separate Text or Stat floating beside or over the header. With an aside, the actions sit under the text. background 'plain' (no panel), 'tint' (a soft panel in the accent), 'gradient' (accent wash), 'image' (imageUrl behind a dark overlay, white text) or 'dark' (deep accent panel, white text); icon (lucide name) in a rounded tile beside the title; align left or center (the aside goes under the text); size compact, default or large. Styles accentColor (else the theme's primary), titleFontFamily ('serif', 'display', ...). Height: grows with its content (about 150px default, 120px compact, 220px large; add 40px for actions under the text)

board.customCards: For card content the fields cannot express (buttons on a card, a custom layout), set cardLayout "custom" and cardHeight (px, the same for every card), then add child components with parent_ref to the board (no slot_name, or "body"). They are laid out on the card canvas: 43 grid columns across the card width (about 7px each on a 3-column board), top in px from the card top. Bind them to {{cardData.<field>}}; every card renders the same children with its own row. A button on a card can act on that card with cardData.id. Children of a board left on Fields content are never shown. Prefer Fields when the mapped fields fit: they need no layout and look right by default.
board.sizing: collapsedHeight (px of card content): taller cards show only that top part with a Show more toggle; put what must always be visible above it (title, owner, status) and details below. Empty shows every card whole; the Show more toggle appears on hover. Columns fold to a narrow strip from a chevron in their header (collapsibleColumns, on by default) and still take dropped cards; collapsedColumns lists column ids folded at start (e.g. a Done or Closed column on a long-running board); components.<name>.collapsedColumns is the current list. columnWidth (px) fixes every column, and the board scrolls sideways when they do not fit; empty shares the board width (at least 240px each).
board.content: A card shows only the fields you map: titleField, descriptionField, badgeField (priority words colour the badge), tagsField (an array or a comma list), progressField (0 to 100), metaField (a short date or count), avatarField (a name, shown as initials). Map what the job needs; leave the rest empty. density "compact" for long boards.
board.saving: Every change shows on the board at once and fires an event with its payload: onCardMoved (lastCardMovement { cardId, card, from, to, toIndex }: card is the moved row, to its new column), onCardAdded (lastAddedCard), onCardUpdated (lastUpdatedCard), onCardRemoved (lastRemovedCard); components.<name>.updatedCardData is the whole board. A card click fires onCardSelected with lastSelectedCard. Save in that event handler with a query. The actions (addCard, updateCardData, moveCard, deleteCard) fire the same events, so either call an action and save in its event, or save with a query and refresh the data; never both, or the save runs twice. Keep allowDrag on when a column is something a card can change (stage, status, owner, assignee): dragging is how people expect to change it, so save the move in onCardMoved. Turn it off only when columns are fixed facts (a date, a site).
board.addFlow: allowAdd shows an Add card button under each column: it sets addCardColumn and fires onAddCardClick. Open a modal form there; on submit run the insert with status components.<name>.addCardColumn, then refresh the data query (or call addCard without a separate insert).
board.deleteFlow: allowDelete shows a delete button on card hover: the card leaves the board and onCardRemoved fires with lastRemovedCard; delete the row in that handler.
board.styles: Every colour falls back to the app theme, so set only what the design needs to blend in: accentColor (selection outline, progress bars, drop line, hover borders); columns: columnBackgroundColor, columnBorderColor, columnBorderRadius (px), columnTitleColor, columnCountBackgroundColor, columnCountTextColor, columnGap (px); cards: cardBackgroundColor, cardBorderColor, cardBorderRadius (px), cardShadow ("none" | "sm" | "md" | "lg", default "sm"), cardTitleColor, cardTextColor (description, meta, progress label), progressColor (progress bars; else the accent). properties.badgeColors maps badge values to colours, e.g. { High: "#dc2626", Low: "#16a34a" } (tinted chip, coloured text); unnamed values keep the built-in colours. Take colours from the app theme or brand, never the defaults of another product.

ShadMap.name: ShadMap
ShadMap.description: Map with markers from rows, on open map tiles (no API key): delivery stops and routes, field jobs and service zones, stores, sites, listings, incidents. data: rows read through latField and lngField (numbers or numeric text; rows without valid coordinates, or at exactly 0, 0, are skipped and counted in a footnote), titleField, subtitleField (a second line: the address), statusField and idField. Pins are coloured by status: by its words (Delivered or Done green, Delayed or Pending amber, Failed or Overdue red, Open, Scheduled or In transit blue; or a tone name success | warning | danger | info), or by statusColors ({ 'Under offer': '#d97706', Open: 'warning' }); showLegend (on) lists the colours with counts. labelField puts a short value in the pin (a stop number) or, longer, a price pill ('€450k'); iconField puts a lucide icon in the pin ('snowflake', 'droplets', 'zap'); markerIcon sets one icon for every pin (iconField wins per row). headingField (degrees, 0 north, clockwise) turns the icon or image to where a vehicle is going, best with 'navigation' or 'plane'. imageField shows an image per row (an https URL, a path or a data URI, SVG included; it should point north for heading) instead of the pin, with a ring of its status colour; a broken or unsafe URL keeps the pin. markerSize: small, medium (default) or large. Routes: connectMarkers draws a line through the markers in routeOrderField order, one per routeField value (a driver, a van), from routeStart (a depot { lat, lng }) when given; routes (a second dataset) draws lines from rows { name, path: [[lat, lng], ...] or a GeoJSON LineString, color or status }; routeColors names each line's colour. Areas (zones, territories, geofences): areas rows with an outline (areaShapeField: [[lat, lng], ...], a GeoJSON Polygon or its JSON text) or a circle (lat, lng and areaRadiusField in metres), titled by areaTitleField and filled by areaStatusField's tone (or the row's color). A click on a marker selects it (selectedMarker: its row, selectedMarkerId), opens a popup with the title, status and popupFields (a comma list of field specs as the Record list's metaFields: 'driver', 'eta:ETA {}', 'total|currency'; showPopup off for none) and fires onMarkerClick; a click on a line or area exposes selectedShape (its row) and selectedShapeType ('route' | 'area') and fires onShapeClicked; a click on the map clears the selection, exposes clickedLocation { lat, lng } and fires onMapClicked. pickLocation lets the user click (or drag a pin) to choose a spot: pickedLocation { lat, lng, address } and onLocationPicked (defaultPickedLocation starts it); showSearch adds an address search box (OpenStreetMap Nominatim by default, rate-limited; geocoderUrl and reverseGeocoderUrl, with {query} or {lat} and {lng}, point it at another geocoder). display 'heat' (or 'both') draws density instead of pins, weighted by heatField. clusterMarkers groups crowded pins into counts (on by default; keeps thousands of rows smooth). fitToMarkers (on by default) opens on everything drawn and refits when data changes; off, the map opens on defaultCenter ({ lat, lng }, [lat, lng] or 'lat, lng') at defaultZoom (1 to 18; 12 is a city, 15 a street). scrollWheelZoom is off by default (the page scrolls past the map; Ctrl or Cmd with the wheel zooms); showFullscreen adds a fullscreen button; mapStyle 'satellite' shows imagery and showStyleSwitch a Map | Satellite toggle. Exposes center, zoom and bounds after every move; onBoundsChange fires when the user pans or zooms. Actions: setCenter(lat, lng, zoom), setZoom, fitBounds, selectMarker(id), clearSelection, setPickedLocation(lat, lng), clearPickedLocation, setMapStyle('streets' | 'satellite'). Height: fixed (the map fills it); give it 320 to 640px

authoringHints.usage: Places on a map, key-free (open tiles that follow the light or dark theme): delivery stops and routes, field jobs and service zones, stores, sites, technicians, listings, incidents, in place of a table of addresses when where matters. data rows with latField and lngField (numbers or numeric text; rows without valid coordinates are skipped and counted in a footnote, so geocode addresses in the query first), titleField, subtitleField (the address), statusField and idField. Pin colours: statusField's words (Delivered or Done green, Delayed, Pending or Under offer amber, Failed, Overdue or Overloaded red, Open, Scheduled or In transit blue, Sold grey); when two states would share a colour (Open and Scheduled are both blue), set statusColors { Open: 'warning', Scheduled: 'info', Reserved: '#7c3aed' }; showLegend (on) explains the colours with counts. labelField: a stop number inside the pin (dispatch) or a price pill ('€450k'; map the rows to a formatted label first) for listings; iconField: a lucide icon per row ('snowflake', 'droplets', 'zap', 'wrench'). Routes: connectMarkers true with routeField (the driver or van: one line each, its own colour, in the legend), routeOrderField (the stop number) and routeStart (the depot { lat, lng }); or routes, a second dataset of lines { name, path: [[lat, lng], ...] or a GeoJSON LineString, status or color }; routeColors names a colour per line. Areas (service zones, territories, geofences, delivery radius): areas rows with an outline ([[lat, lng], ...], a GeoJSON Polygon or JSON text in areaShapeField) or a circle (lat, lng and a radius in metres), named by areaTitleField and filled by areaStatusField's tone (Busy amber, Overloaded red) or the row's color. popupFields lists what the popup shows under the title ('eta:ETA {}, driver, total|currency'). Wire onMarkerClick to a details sheet or a side panel from components.<map>.selectedMarker (the row) and selectedMarkerId; a list beside the map calls selectMarker(id) on its row click to bring the pin into view and open its popup. onShapeClicked with selectedShape (the route or area row) and selectedShapeType. To choose a place in a form (a new job, a new site), a ShadMap with pickLocation true and showSearch true (data '{{[]}}', defaultCenter and defaultZoom 11 on the city, fitToMarkers false, about 260px tall): the user searches an address or clicks; save components.<map>.pickedLocation.lat / .lng and .address, and react in onLocationPicked; defaultPickedLocation shows the saved spot when editing. display 'heat' (or 'both') shows density, weighted by heatField. fitToMarkers (on) opens on everything drawn and refits when data changes; off, defaultCenter at defaultZoom (12 a city, 15 a street). clusterMarkers (on) keeps thousands of rows smooth; set it off for under about 50 pins that should all show, and with numbered stops. Page scroll is never taken by the map (scrollWheelZoom off; Ctrl or Cmd with the wheel zooms); showFullscreen (on) adds a button; mapStyle 'satellite' or showStyleSwitch for site work. onBoundsChange with components.<map>.bounds { northEast, southWest } can drive a 'what is in view' query; onMapClicked exposes clickedLocation. Never put coordinates in an Html widget or an iframe map. Fixed height: 320 to 640px, a page column beside a ShadRecordList or ShadCardGrid of the same rows; not in a fit-to-content container.
